summary.text: Carl Anderson is the Democratic candidate for Montana State Senate District 34 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Caleb Hinkle, who defeated incumbent Shelley Vance in the Republican primary.
Anderson was the Democratic nominee for Montana House of Representatives District 67 in 2024, when he lost to incumbent Jedediah Hinkle, 63.4 percent to 36.6 percent.
